statement: The actual positive-w-loop smooth monodromy is zero in Theta7. Its oriented mapping torus is S1 times S6 and every finite cyclic base change has trivial monodromy.
notes: First determination: exact integer cancellation J=0 and equivariant sixfold-to-onefold additivity. C.3.27 supplies the independent index/spin-c determination with shared p,k inputs. The specific analytic B.4 filling remains Open.
